text: Standing research-owned record gap that no remaining stage can clear. The reviewed research records lag the accepted study at four points the study author and two study reviewers recorded: research/interpretations.md and research/scope.md still say Chrysostom 'disputes' Augustine on Acts 16:14, which the accepted study no longer says; the records say Jerome expounds Matthew 20:16b; and scope.md omits Chrysostom's second application of his rule (64.3) and two details of Aquinas. None changes a claim in any of the three documents or the web edition. No stage after research-review writes research records, and the driver adds no findings of its own; the driver therefore does not manufacture a blocking finding to force a research re-entry, which would re-run every document and review for records no reader sees. The gap stands in the standing-findings record and in the run's cycle record.
